# FOX 10 Phoenix

> FOX 10 Phoenix (KSAZ-TV) is the primary local news and weather source for the Phoenix, Arizona metropolitan area, offering comprehensive coverage of news, weather forecasts, sports, and live streams.

FOX 10 Phoenix serves the greater Phoenix Valley region with real-time weather updates, local news reporting, and coverage of Arizona sports teams including the Diamondbacks, Cardinals, and Suns. The station features multiple shows and a robust video library for on-demand content.

## Key Topics

- Phoenix, Arizona
- Local News
- Weather Forecasts
- Live Streams
- Current Weather Conditions

- KSAZ-TV
